# GovernanceOS (governanceos) — full text

This file is the "full" edition of the llms.txt standard, for long-context models that read the whole repo description at once.

## What this is

`governanceos` is a *methodology collection*: one operating system that wires the
full AI-agent governance lifecycle end to end — SPEC → PLAN → GATE → AUDIT. It
does **not** re-implement security logic. It routes you, phase by phase, to 9
sub-skills that are already published and maintained on their own. Treat this
repo as the table of contents; the sub-skills are the chapters.

Differentiator vs. external collections (superpowers / ECC / caveman): theory
(LGD three-laws: registered / evidenced / gated) + skills + evidence chain +
supervision charter ship in one auditable unit.

## What problem it solves

1. You want an end-to-end governance plan for an AI agent, not nine loose tools.
2. You need a pre-launch security audit: red-team, injection shield, leak scan,
   document desensitization, kill-switch.
3. You need release-compliance gates before publishing a skill.
4. You want provenance: a badge issued only after gates pass, then verified.

## The four phases

1. **SPEC** — pin governance scope and supervision charter before building.
2. **PLAN (defense in depth)** — `agent-redteam-kit` → `prompt-injection-shield`
   → `prompt-leak-scanner` → `doc-desens-scanner` → `agent-kill-switch`.
3. **GATE (two hard stops)** — `skill-quality-gate` (library admission) and
   `publish-quality-gate` (external publish); desensitization and kill-switch
   wired in as hard stops.
4. **AUDIT (provenance)** — `lgd-badge-issuer` then `lgd-badge-verify`.

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/governanceos.git
cd governanceos

# list the whole lifecycle (4 phases, 9 sub-skills)
python3 scripts/governance_flow.py --list

# get the call note for one phase or slug
python3 scripts/governance_flow.py --route plan
python3 scripts/governance_flow.py --route lgd-badge-verify

# print the live LGD three-law status line
python3 scripts/governance_flow.py --badge
```

Requirements: Python 3. Prefer running `./install.sh` (macOS/Linux) or
`./install.ps1` (Windows) to point your agent CLI at `SKILL.md`.

## Trigger words

治理全流程 / 发布前要过哪些门 / 给我一套治理方法论 / AI-agent governance plan /
pre-launch security audit / release-compliance review / red-team drill /
prompt-injection shield / leak scanner / kill switch / quality gate / badge issue verify.
